pairs: you fat cows that are on the mountain of Samaria,
you who make false accusations against the destitute
quæ calumniam facitis egenis et confringitis pauperes;
Juravit Dominus Deus in sancto suo,
The Lord God has sworn in his holiness:
quia ecce dies venient super vos,
the days that will overcome you and that will impale you on poles,
et reliquias vestras in ollis ferventibus.
and that will place what remains of you in boiling pots.
Et per aperturas exibitis altera contra alteram,
And you will go out through the breaches, one over another,
and you will be cast out into Harmon,
And bring daybreak to your victims,
And offer a sacrifice of praise with leaven.
Unde et ego dedi vobis stuporem dentium in cunctis urbibus vestris,
Therefore, because of this, I have given you dull teeth in every one of your cities,
et indigentiam panum in omnibus locis vestris; et non estis reversi ad me,
and a lack of bread in all your places. And you have not been turned back towards me,
Ego quoque prohibui a vobis imbrem,
Therefore, I have withheld the rains from you,
cum adhuc tres menses superessent usque ad messem:
when there were still three months left until the harvest.
And I rained on one city,
et super alteram civitatem non plui;
and I did not rain on another city;
et pars super quam non plui,
and the part on which I did not rain,
And two and three cities went to one city,
et tres civitates ad unam civitatem ut biberent aquam,
And you did not return to me,
Percussi vos in vento urente, et in aurugine:
I struck you with a burning wind and with yellowing;
multitudinem hortorum vestrorum et vinearum vestrarum,
the caterpillar has consumed your many gardens and your vineyards,
oliveta vestra et ficeta vestra comedit eruca:
your olive groves and your fig groves.
And you did not return to me,
Misi in vos mortem in via Ægypti;
I sent death to you by way of Egypt;
I struck your youths with the sword,
even bringing captivity to your horses.
et ascendere feci putredinem castrorum vestrorum in nares vestras:
And I made the stench of your camp ascend into your nostrils.
And you did not return to me,
Subverti vos sicut subvertit Deus Sodomam
just as God overturned Sodom and Gomorrah,
et facti estis quasi torris raptus ab incendio:
and you became like an ember seized from the fire.
And you did not return to me,
Because of this, I will do these things to you,
But after I have done these things to you,
præparare in occursum Dei tui, Israël.
Israel, be prepared to meet your God.
et creans ventum, et annuntians homini eloquium suum,
he who forms the mountains and creates the wind and announces his speech to man,
faciens matutinam nebulam, et gradiens super excelsa terræ:
who makes the morning mist and steps over the heights of the earth:
the Lord God of hosts is his name.
